adjudication: Author-acknowledged coding mistakes materially affect one negative-binomial patent robustness check. Broader conclusions disputed; earliest public date incompletely resolved.
mechanism: Negative-binomial model used patents+1 instead of raw counts and separate country/year fixed effects instead of country-by-year effects. Comment also drops industry effects to match written equation; reply disputes dropping those effects.
consequence: Reply Table 1 original 0.398 (SE 0.168), corrected counts and country-by-year FE 0.116 (0.490). Correcting dependent variable alone in comment gives -0.15 (0.47). Reply adding initial Chinese import exposure yields 1.089 (0.575), p<.10, with further variants significant at .05/.01.
correction_only: Use 0.398 to 0.116 as agreed coding correction; do not use the negative estimate after disputed FE removal as agreed correction. Changes to log(1+patents) elsewhere concern modeling/estimand and trends. The coding result is a robustness-specification finding, not proof all original innovation, IT and productivity findings reverse.
response_status: Reply acknowledges errors but defends industry FE and argues initial-condition controls restore positive results. This defense uses additional controls beyond the simple coding correction.

original_title: Dictator games: a meta study
adjudication: Full report documents concrete SD/SE and data-entry issues and an important changed take-option result; correction bundle also changes censoring/definition. Material impact of hard mistakes alone not isolated.
mechanism: For List aggregate data, SDs used instead of SEs, underweighting study. Some negative-mean treatments omitted; Bardsley participant counts mistaken across treatments; negative giving truncated to zero in aggregate and excluded from individual data. These issues have different epistemic status: SD/SE and transcription are computational/data errors; censoring and comparable-giving definitions require substantive assessment.
consequence: 2012 working-paper Table 6 take-option meta-regression coefficient -0.331 (p<.001), OLS -0.428 (p<.001), treatment FE -0.272 (p<.001), Tobit -0.362 (p<.001); original take-option estimates nonsignificant. Final 2014 comment reports a different meta coefficient (-0.603) after broader recoding; do not interchange versions. Most other findings described as robust.
correction_only: The displayed consequence follows bundled recoding/reinstatement of negative giving and hard data errors. A hard-errors-only correction is not reported in the inspected full 2012 paper. Separate normalized-giving analyses alter the outcome reference point further.
response_status: No formal Engel response located. Comment acknowledges Engel supplied data and answered questions; that does not establish agreement with all criticisms.
